description: SYNTHETIC TABLE FOR READER TESTS ONLY - not a physical equation of state. p0 is sampled from the analytic development EoS p0 = p_c(rho) + (Gamma_th - 1)(eps - eps_c(rho)) with Gamma_th = 1.33333333333, p_c = rho mu_c - eps_c, from data/eos/cold_curve.dat (C1 cubic Hermite interpolation of the cold curve); the formula is continued smoothly below the cold curve (no clamp). T, mu, s are smooth analytic test functions with no thermodynamic meaning: T = 0.1 GeV x/(1+y); mu = 0.94 GeV + 0.3 GeV y/(1+0.1 y) + 0.005 GeV x; s = 0.5 x (1+0.1 y)/(1+0.01 x) + 0.2 y fm^-3, with x = eps/eps_s, y = rho/rho_s. eps_min(rho) = eps_c(rho).
index_order: p0, T, mu, s: C order, shape (nx, ny), element (ix, iy) at flat index ix*ny + iy (iy fastest); eps_min: shape (ny,) indexed by iy; all float64 little-endian, fields stored consecutively in the order of 'fields'
